about: Curated eclipsing-binary distances for the Magellanic Clouds (approved exception, object framework section 18.18 item 6). They replace every catalogue distance for these two records; the catalogue values are shown as not used. Errors: statistical and systematic added in quadrature, as measured 1-sigma intervals. Every number carries `src` and `where`, re-read in the paper text on 2026-11-19.

dist.where: abstract: 'The final distance is 49.59 ± 0.09 (statistical) ± 0.54 (systematic) kiloparsecs' (20 detached eclipsing binaries)
abstract: 'We derive a distance to the SMC center of DSMC = 62.44 ± 0.47 (stat.) ± 0.81 (syst.) kpc corresponding to a distance modulus (m − M)SMC = 18.977 ± 0.016 ± 0.028 mag'
